Sobre a posição Atuação na operação, acompanhamento e otimização de campanhas de mídia digital, garantindo a correta configuração das campanhas, qualidade das entregas, acompanhamento dos indicadores de performance e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria. A posição terá interface com as áreas de mídia, dados, produto e tecnologia, atuando desde a programação e parametrização das campanhas até a análise de resultados e resolução de problemas operacionais. Responsabilidades e atribuições Configurar, parametrizar e programar campanhas de mídia digital em plataformas de ad serving, como Google Ad Manager (GAM). Realizar o tráfego de campanhas e acompanhar a veiculação, garantindo o cumprimento das especificações, períodos e volumes planejados. Monitorar indicadores de performance e entrega, como impressões, CPM, CPC, CTR, conversões e demais KPIs das campanhas. Identificar desvios de entrega e oportunidades de otimização, realizando ajustes de configuração, segmentação e distribuição das campanhas. Apoiar a realização de testes A/B e outras iniciativas de otimização de performance. Analisar dados de campanhas, identificando padrões, desvios e oportunidades relacionados à performance, engajamento e conversão. Elaborar análises e business insights a partir dos resultados das campanhas. Realizar auditorias técnicas e operacionais, acompanhando volumetria, parametrizações e consistência das entregas. Monitorar o inventário de mídia digital, considerando ocupação, disponibilidade e capacidade de entrega. Identificar e solucionar problemas relacionados a tags, pixels, UTMs, parametrizações e discrepâncias de dados entre plataformas. Levantar demandas e atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Produto e Tecnologia para correções e melhorias nos ambientes digitais. Contribuir para a melhoria dos processos de operação, acompanhamento e mensuração das campanhas. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência profissional em operações de mídia digital, Ad Operations, mídia programática, performance ou áreas relacionadas. Experiência com configuração, parametrização e acompanhamento de campanhas digitais. Conhecimento de métricas de mídia e performance, como CPM, CPC, CTR, conversões, impressões e volumetria. Conhecimento em plataformas de ad serving e/ou gerenciamento de campanhas digitais. Conhecimento de tags, pixels, UTMs e conceitos de tracking e mensuração. Experiência com análise de dados e identificação de desvios e oportunidades de otimização. Organização e atenção aos detalhes para acompanhamento de diferentes campanhas e entregas. Boa comunicação e facilidade para atuar em parceria com diferentes áreas Será um diferencial: Experiência com Google Ad Manager (GAM). Conhecimento de mídia programática e do ecossistema de publicidade digital. Experiência com campanhas de display e diferentes formatos de mídia digital. Experiência com projetos especiais ou branded content. Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados. Vivência em projetos com interface entre mídia, produto e tecnologia. Informações adicionais A posição exige atuação analítica e operacional, com acompanhamento contínuo das campanhas, identificação de inconsistências e interação com diferentes áreas para garantir a qualidade das entregas e dos resultados. Beneficíos Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale transporte Vale Alimentação PPR (Programa de Participação de Resultados) Wellhub Educação corporativa

review_candidates.description: Job Description Do you enjoy helping international B2B companies increase visibility, generate leads, and strengthen their market position? As an Account Manager at CNS Media in Arnhem, you’ll help clients achieve their goals through integrated digital media solutions while driving sales and developing new business. You’ll build long-term relationships with clients, helping organizations maximize their marketing impact. Who are we? CNS Media is an international B2B media company connecting professionals in the food ingredients, nutrition, packaging and personal care industries with the latest news, innovations, insights and trends. We support international companies through integrated digital media solutions, including advertising, lead generation, webinars, content and thought leadership opportunities. What will you do? As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in growing our international client portfolio and helping companies achieve their marketing goals through effective digital media solutions. You will build strong relationships with new and existing B2B clients, identify business opportunities, advise on tailored media strategies, and sell integrated campaigns across the CNS Media portfolio. You will combine a consultative sales approach with strong commercial awareness to create value for clients and drive growth. Your role will include managing client relationships through calls, Teams meetings, visits and industry events, while maintaining a structured sales pipeline and accurate CRM administration in Odoo. You will also represent CNS Media at 2–3 leading trade shows across Europe each year and lead international client visits, giving you the opportunity to expand your network and develop new partnerships. Job Requirements Who Are You? 2–5 years of experience in B2B account management, consultative sales, or business development, preferably within media, advertising, publishing or marketing services. Well organized, commercially curious and proactive. With a strong ability to identify opportunities and develop new business. Confident communicator, skilled at building trust and strong client relationships. Relationship-driven and results-focused, motivated to achieve commercial success. Fluent in English, both written and spoken, and comfortable working in an international business environment. In possession of a valid driver’s license. What We Offer A competitive gross monthly salary between €3,000 and €4,500 (based on a full-time, 40-hour work week), depending on your knowledge and experience. An attractive performance-based bonus scheme that rewards success. A solid pension plan with a 50% employer contribution. 25 days of annual leave, with the option to purchase up to 10 additional days each year. Once your onboarding is complete, you will have the opportunity to work from home one day per week. Opportunities to travel internationally to visit clients and explore new markets. Plenty of opportunities for personal development and career growth. Access to a fully equipped on-site gym to help you stay healthy and energized.

review_candidates.location: Ramat Gan, Tel Aviv District, Israel
review_candidates.description: We’re looking for an AI Product Manager to join our product team and take ownership of products and features from idea to impact. This is a full-time, office-based role from our Ramat Gan office, five days a week. What You’ll Do Own features end to end: define them, write clear specs and tickets, work closely with developers, and validate the result in production. Own the product and traffic outcomes of what you ship: rankings, clicks, Search Console, GA4, and PostHog are part of your daily tools. Build and improve AI agents and automations that support your research, QA, analysis, and day-to-day product work. Run the weekly product loop: understand what moved, why it moved, and what we should change next. Why This Role You’ll see your work go live. We move quickly - ideas become tickets, tickets become releases, and your work reaches millions of users. You’ll own the outcome. You’re not just handing specs over to development. You’ll follow what happens after launch, understand the results, and continuously improve what you ship. AI is part of how we work, not a side project. You’ll build and use AI agents and automations as part of your everyday work - and continuously find ways to make them better. You’ll have real ownership. We’re a small, hands-on team, which means you’ll be close to the technology, the decisions, and the impact. Requirements 2+ years of experience working on a technology product - in Product, Development, UX/UI, or another role closely involved in building and shipping products. AI is already a meaningful part of how you work. You’ve built automations, agents, skills, or other AI-powered workflows that did real work, and you can walk us through what you built and how. Excellent written English. Our tickets, specs, and prompts are written in English, and you know how to turn an idea into a clear, actionable spec. Strong ownership and independent problem-solving. You’re comfortable entering a new domain, learning what you need, figuring out the next step, and recognizing when an AI tool is giving you the wrong answer. This isn’t a senior role by title. We’re looking for someone smart, capable, curious, and ambitious who wants meaningful ownership, works well close to the technology, and is excited to grow quickly as part of a fast-moving product team.
